about_the_game:
About This Game

Chrono Agents is a chilling cooperative horror mystery that thrusts you into the shadows of time itself. Alone or with up to three friends, you will leap into cursed timelines, investigate unsettling murders, and gather evidence of creatures that were never meant to exist. Each era is filled with dark secrets, eerie environments, and the constant fear of what lurks unseen. Only through sharp observation, courage, and teamwork can you survive the horrors hidden across centuries.

Features

Time Travel Investigation
Jump across cursed timelines, explore eerie settings, and uncover clues behind gruesome murders.

Uncover the Supernatural
Collect evidence of terrifying creatures and prove they exist—or risk becoming their next victim.

Beware the Unknown
Dark forces stalk every era. Footsteps, whispers, and shadows may not be your imagination.

Develop Your Skills
Sharpen your observation, deduction, and survival instincts to face increasingly dangerous timelines.

Tools of the Agent
Use mystical gadgets and forensic tools to reveal hidden clues and defend against the impossible.

Co-op or Solo Horror
Face the terror alone or join up to three friends. Teamwork is key, but fear is shared.

In-Game Voice Chat
Coordinate your investigation in real-time—but beware: speaking too loudly may draw unwanted attention.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 || AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 TI || Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-9900k || AMD Ryzen 9 3900X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 2070 || RX 5700XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
